SELECT t1.JM_CD AS jmCd , t1.KOSCOM_CD AS koscomCd , t1.JJ_NM AS jjNm , t1.JJ_ENM AS jjEnm , t1.BALH_CO AS balhCo FROM SJM0JJ t1 WHERE t1.DANC_GB IN ('A', 'C', 'D', 'G')
AND NVL(t1.ABOL_DT, #{ymd}) >= #{ymd}
AND NVL(t1.ABOL_DT, CURRENT_DATE) >= CURRENT_DATE
ORDER BY F_JM_SORT ( NVL(#{corpGr}, '00'),
#{ymd} CURRENT_DATE , t1.JM_CD ) , t1.KOSCOM_CD

SELECT t1.YMD AS ymd , t1.CLOSE AS close , t1.VOLUME AS volume , t1.VALUE / 100000000 AS value , t1.PRECLOSE AS preclose , t1.CHANGE AS change FROM SJT1TG t1 WHERE t1.KOSCOM_CD = #{koscomCd}
AND t1.YMD >= ADD_MONTHS(#{ymd}, -12)
AND t1.YMD >= ADD_MONTHS(CURRENT_DATE, -12)
ORDER BY t1.YMD DESC
